/bin/bash -lc 'export API_KEY=$(cat "$GALAXY_API_KEY_FILE"); python3 - <<'"'PY'
import os, json, time
from bioblend.galaxy import GalaxyInstance
gi=GalaxyInstance('https://usegalaxy.org', os.environ['API_KEY'])
hist='bbd44e69cb8906b5c52ef6c9995e9a1b'
tool='toolshed.g2.bx.psu.edu/repos/goeckslab/gseapy_enrichr/gseapy_enrichr/0.1.0+galaxy2'
libs=['Disease_Perturbations_from_GEO_up','Disease_Perturbations_from_GEO_down','ARCHS4_Cell-lines','PanglaoDB_Augmented_2021','Jensen_DISEASES','MGI_Mammalian_Phenotype_Level_4_2021']
jobs={}
for lib in libs:
    inputs={
     'gene_list|input': {'id':'f9cad7b01a4721353f9eabb295808f7f','src':'hda'},
     'gene_list|delimiter':'line','gene_list|has_header':False,'gene_list|column':'1',
     'gene_sets|source':'library','gene_sets|library_name':lib,'gene_sets|organism':'mouse',
     'background|selector':'no',
     'summary_options|sort_by':'p_value','summary_options|top_n':'20'
    }
    try:
      res=gi.tools.run_tool(history_id=hist, tool_id=tool, tool_inputs=inputs)
      jid=res['jobs'][0]['id']
      outputs=res['outputs']
      top=[o['id'] for o in outputs if o.get('output_name')=='top_terms']
      results=[o['id'] for o in outputs if o.get('output_name')=='results']
      summary=[o['id'] for o in outputs if o.get('output_name')=='term_summary']
      jobs[lib]={'job':jid,'top':top[0] if top else None,'results':results[0] if results else None,'summary':summary[0] if summary else None}
      print('SUBMITTED',lib,jid,flush=True)
    except Exception as e:
      print('SUBMIT_FAIL',lib,repr(e),flush=True)
pending=set(jobs)
for i in range(90):
    if not pending: break
    for lib in list(pending):
        jid=jobs[lib]['job']
        try:
            st=gi.jobs.show_job(jid)['state']
        except Exception as e:
            print('POLL_ERR',lib,repr(e),flush=True); continue
        if st in ('ok','error','deleted','failed'):
            print('TERMINAL',lib,st,jid,flush=True)
            pending.remove(lib)
    if pending:
        time.sleep(5)
print('DONE pending',pending,flush=True)
print(json.dumps(jobs,indent=2))
PY"
